verification.title: Domain confirmation
verification.subtitle: Confirms the store is yours. Checkout checks do not run until the domain is confirmed.
verification.plugin_hint: Easiest: the plugin publishes the confirmation code on your site by itself.
verification.dns_hint: Add a TXT record at your domain registrar or DNS provider.
verification.dns_help: Add a TXT record with these values to your domain DNS. DNS updates can take a few hours.
verification.plugin_help: The plugin receives the code with its next signal (within 5 minutes) and publishes it on your site. Nothing to do.

reason.challenge_mismatch: The site responds, but the code does not match. The plugin may not have received the new code yet.
reason.store_url_changed: The store address changed during the check. Start the confirmation again.
reason.connection_failed: Could not connect to the site.
reason.dns_failure: The domain could not be found in DNS.
reason.http_status_unexpected: The site returned an error. Check that the plugin is active.
reason.redirect_not_allowed: The site redirects to another address. Check the store address.
reason.response_too_large: The site returned an unexpectedly large response.
reason.unsafe_destination: The address points into a private network and cannot be checked.
reason.other: The check has not passed yet.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.subtitle: Problems the service found in your stores. “Acknowledged” means seen, not fixed.

empty.active_note: That does not mean everything is fine if the store data is incomplete. See the coverage on the store page.

title.MONEY_CAPTURE_MISSING: Order marked as paid, no capture found at the provider
title.MONEY_CAPTURE_AMOUNT: Captured amount differs from the order total
title.MONEY_REFUND_MISSING: Refund in the store, not found at the provider
title.MONEY_REFUND_EXTRA: Refund at the provider that the store does not show
title.MONEY_MULTIPLE_CAPTURES: Several different captures for one order
title.MONEY_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Capture currency differs from the order currency
title.MONEY_PAYMENT_WITHOUT_ORDER: Provider payment not matched to an order
title.CHECKOUT_FLOW_FAILED: The check did not reach the payment form
title.CHECKOUT_TEST_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: The test product for checks is unavailable
title.CHECKOUT_ADAPTER_UNSUPPORTED: This site's checkout is not supported by the check yet
title.INTEGRATION_STALE: The store plugin is not reporting
title.INTEGRATION_DELIVERY_DELAYED: The store plugin is sending data late

advice.MONEY_UNSUPPORTED: The order's payment method is not supported by reconciliation. Check the payment manually in the provider dashboard.
advice.MONEY_CAPTURE_MISSING: Find the transaction in the provider dashboard and check the order status. If the payment went through under another reference, match it manually. Not finding a capture does not prove the money is missing.
advice.MONEY_CAPTURE_AMOUNT: Compare the order total with the provider capture: a partial capture, an order change or a gateway error are possible.
advice.MONEY_REFUND_MISSING: Check whether the refund was actually sent through the provider and not only marked in the store.
advice.MONEY_REFUND_EXTRA: Check who issued the refund in the provider dashboard and whether the order should reflect it.
advice.MONEY_MULTIPLE_CAPTURES: Check whether the customer was charged twice. Refund if necessary.
advice.MONEY_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Check the currency settings of the store and the payment gateway.
advice.MONEY_ORDER_CHANGED: The order was edited after payment. Make sure the final total and the capture agree.
advice.MONEY_PAYMENT_WITHOUT_ORDER: Find the payment in the provider dashboard and work out which order it belongs to. A match by amount and time is only a hint.
advice.CHECKOUT_PAYMENTS_FAILING: Try paying with this method yourself and check the payment plugin log and the provider dashboard.
advice.CHECKOUT_FLOW_FAILED: Open the site and walk the path to payment: product, cart, checkout. Look at the check screenshot. This check does not verify that charging succeeds.
advice.CHECKOUT_TEST_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: Make sure the test product is published, in stock and can be added to the cart.
advice.CHECKOUT_MONITORING_BLOCKED: Site protection (WAF, CAPTCHA) blocks the check. This is not a store failure, but the store cannot be checked right now.
advice.CHECKOUT_ADAPTER_UNSUPPORTED: The theme or checkout plugins are not supported yet. This is not a store failure; we cannot check this path.
advice.INTEGRATION_STALE: Check that the site is up and the Business Watchdog plugin is active. This does not mean sales stopped, but while the plugin is silent the service cannot see orders.
advice.INTEGRATION_DELIVERY_DELAYED: The plugin is behind with sending data. Check that scheduled tasks run on the site (WP-Cron or Action Scheduler).
advice.unknown: Open the details below and check the affected part of the store.

resolution.auto_resolved_fresh_reconciliation_ok: a fresh reconciliation found no discrepancy

fields.window_note: The failure started somewhere between these two moments; it cannot be narrowed down further.

actions.title: Actions
actions.acknowledged_note: The incident is acknowledged: seen, not fixed yet.
actions.resolve_reason: What was done or why you are resolving it
actions.resolve_note: Monitoring keeps running: if the failure happens again, the incident reopens.
actions.snooze_note: The incident state does not change; no notifications are sent for it until the time is up.
actions.recheck_check_done: Check started. The result appears in a few minutes.
actions.resolved_note: The incident is resolved. Monitoring continues: it reopens if the failure happens again.

evidence.title: Facts
evidence.screenshot_note: Input fields and addresses are masked in the screenshot.
evidence.screenshot_alt: Screenshot of the page at the step where the check stopped

facts.payment_streak: Payment method “{method}”: {n} failed attempts in a row (threshold {threshold}).

connector_reason.heartbeats_missed: The plugin missed several signals in a row.
connector_reason.no_heartbeat_since_pairing: No signal from the plugin since it was connected.
connector_reason.delivery_backlog: The plugin has a backlog of unsent events.

check_error.site_failure: The site did not let the check reach the payment form.
check_error.blocked_external_origin: The page called an address the check does not allow.
check_error.forbidden_mutation: The page tried a forbidden action; the check stopped.
check_error.selector_changed: A page element was not found: the site theme may have changed.
check_error.adapter_unsupported: The site's checkout is not supported by the check.

reconciliation.title: Money reconciliation
reconciliation.subtitle: Compares what the store considers paid and refunded with the payment provider's data. The store's “paid” marker alone does not prove a capture.

coverage.provider_not_connected: Without a connected payment provider, captures and refunds are not visible, so every reconciliation result is “unknown”, not “all fine”.
coverage.store_not_connected: The store plugin is not connected: the service cannot see orders.
coverage.store_data_stale: Store data is stale: until the plugin sends fresh data, reconciliation results are undetermined.

filter.current_note: The latest result for each order.
filter.history_note: Every result of every check, newest first.

reconciliation.empty_unknown: No results. Without a connected provider this does not mean there are no discrepancies.

unmatched.subtitle: Provider captures that could not be matched to an order. A matching payment reference is a strong hint; amount and time alone are only a reason to check manually.

confidence.manual_review: only the amount matches — check manually

unmatched.no_candidates: No matching orders found. Check the payment in the provider dashboard.
unmatched.link_warning: The whole capture will count towards this order. The action is logged and can be revoked on the order page.
unmatched.linked: Payment matched. The order is reconciled again automatically.

order.title: Order {number}

financial_support.unsupported: not supported for this payment method

order.paid_marker_note: The “paid” marker comes from the store and does not prove a capture by itself. Provider amounts are from the latest reconciliation.
order.no_findings: The order has not been reconciled yet.
order.no_allocations: No provider capture is matched to this order.
order.revoke_capture_warning: The capture will no longer count towards this order and the order is reconciled again. A revoked link cannot be restored, only created again.
order.revoke_refund_warning: The provider refund will no longer count towards this store refund and the order is reconciled again.
order.link_refund_warning: The provider refund will count towards the chosen store refund. The action is logged.
order.nothing_to_link: The chosen refunds are already fully linked.
